description: Hi! We are students from middle school in Mexico and we are so gratefull to be here and that you´ll be joining us!
summary: For the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we created a board game called MOONLINK. The game is about a lunar base that loses communication with Earth because of a solar storm. The purpose is to teach people about space communication, teamwork, and problem-solving in a fun way.
details: Our game works by having players complete missions, answer questions, and solve challenges to reconnect the Moon base with Earth. It helps people learn about space communication, teamwork, and problem-solving. Our goal is to make learning about space fun and interesting. We used cardboard, paper, printed cards, and Canva to create the game. Our idea is creative because it turns a real space problem into a fun board game. We considered the rules, materials, time, and how to make it easy for everyone to play.
projectRefs: Lunar Communications Relay and Navigation Systems
